gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-montserrat-alter: Precise and typewriter-tidy, Fragment Mono spaces every letter alike. Montserrat Alternates, a sans-serif with round, chalkboard-tall lowercase, gets more room to breathe if you size it up a touch from the default.
gen-gf-frijole-gf-graduate: Expressive to the point of mischief, Frijole stretches its words wide and nearly seals its curves. Graduate, a classic serif drawn like a marker, does the opposite job: a steady, dignified line with generous spacing, built for sentences rather than shouting.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-gambetta: Funnel Display draws everything like spaghetti, one width from start to finish with open c tips. And Gambetta, a serif with a lightly flexed stroke and a taller lowercase, gives the page something bookish and graceful to settle into beneath it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-abyssinica-sil: Commanding in its uniform, noodle-like strokes, Funnel Display sits above Abyssinica SIL, a serif whose line swells softly like brushed watercolor. Give that tall-bodied text a little extra size.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-cambo: Funnel Display draws its letters like cut cord, one width throughout. Cambo, a serif with soft contrast in each curve, is gentler, so a heading made small would lose its punch against it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-fanwood-text: Smooth, rounded, and cord-like, this heading speaks in Funnel Display's single steady stroke. Fanwood Text, a serif with large-eyed lowercase and gentle swelling curves, then carries a long passage with a literary, bookish hush.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Open, wiry letters meet a heavy, towering slab here. Funnel Display does best at drawing one stroke width through the whole alphabet, while Holtwood One SC, a classic serif with nearly closed curves, delivers weight and authority.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-manuale: Cord-thick strokes, crossbars as sturdy as the stems, and a commanding air define Funnel Display up top. Below it, Manuale reads in a traditional, editorial way over a long passage.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-naskh-arab: Funnel Display draws its curves at the thickness of a drawn thread, expressive and bold in the same stroke width throughout. Its best quality is the contrast with Noto Naskh Arabic, a refined text serif with a very tall x-height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-nastaliq-u: Noto Nastaliq Urdu reads tight and dignified, with little ascender height. Funnel Display does its best work as a bold, single-stroke headline, while this text serif does its best in a subtle, etched-glass line.
